Description.Name: AC/20 Ammo
Description.Details:
Caseless Ammunition is special, it has no shell or case. This provides an advantage of more ammunition per bin, but a disadvantage in a much higher recoil impulse.  Ammo Bins contain the rounds needed for projectile-based weaponry, with at least one bin required per weapon type. Ammo Bins will explode and destroy their installed location when they receive a Critical Hit.

AC/20 Ammo Bins each contain 8 rounds and may feed multiple weapons.
